sum: Pramanand Commercial Private Limited has filed a disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4) for a substantial acquisition of shares in Chambal Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited. The filing signals acquisition of significant shareholding triggering mandatory SEBI takeover disclosure requirements.
detail: Pramanand Commercial Private Limited has submitted to NSE a disclosure document under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is mandatory whenever an acquirer crosses the 5% threshold of voting shares (or each additional 2% thereafter). The filing to NSE on 29 June 2026 confirms acquisition activity but does not disclose the final consideration, offer structure, or open offer intent—those details remain within the PDF filing with the exchange.
